scope: PR #12 second review batch, including the updated PR #11 base
source_state: Working tree changes listed below, validated before the fix commit; evidence text was added afterward.

tools/qa/fake_agent.py: module usage documents the added option

tools/qa/fake_agent.py: checkpoint recognizes the value

findings.rationale: Valid test-strength gap. The old global word subset could not detect a conversation moved between harnesses. The assertion now pairs each saved identity with its registered harness and requires that pair in that harness process arguments. Same-harness agent swaps remain outside ps-argument distinguishability.
evidence: tools/qa/breakit.py: Run.s_reboot_restore builds expected (harness, conversation) pairs
tools/qa/breakit.py: resumed_pairs associates fake process arguments with the installed harness binary token

findings.rationale: The version field is part of the durable resume-record schema written by write_resume_record, so read_resume_record now accepts only version 1 while retaining safe open/fstat ownership checks. Record validation now precedes the filesystem probe, restoring invalid_argument semantics and avoiding an unnecessary probe.
evidence: services/session/src/agent_checkpoint.cpp: decode/read_resume_record validates version 1
services/session/src/agent_checkpoint.cpp: write_resume_record validates ResumeRecord before safe_existing
services/session/tests/agent_checkpoint_test.cpp: records_are_private adds a version-2 rejection

findings.rationale: Retrying after an unsuccessful durable write is necessary to recover without losing the latest checkpoint. A rate-limited writer needs a queued-latest-value/flush-on-exit design to preserve that guarantee. No measured output or disk saturation is supplied; retain write-then-commit correctness and defer a broader scheduling change.
evidence: services/session/src/session_service.cpp: SessionService::note_conversation is the call path
services/session/src/agent_checkpoint.cpp: write_resume_record uses QSaveFile plus commit

findings.rationale: False positive as suggested. Comparing only the first DNS label would accept unrelated remote DNS names that share the local label and weaken the existing host boundary. No durable FQDN/canonical-host contract or evidence was provided; fail-closed is correct until a reviewed host-identity normalization contract exists.
evidence: services/session/src/agent_checkpoint.cpp: local_host intentionally compares normalized exact host strings and strips only .local

findings.rationale: The probes are bounded and preserve conservative running-service rejection; transcript traversal follows the constrained recorded layout. Asynchronous startup/caching requires a separate measured change with lifetime/cancellation contracts. The review identifies an unmeasured latency concern, not a failed current recovery behavior.
evidence: apps/desktop/src/workspace.cpp: Workspace::restore loops serviceRunning and restoredLaunch synchronously
apps/desktop/src/workspace.cpp: serviceRunning uses waitForConnected(250)
apps/desktop/src/workspace.cpp: conversationSaved walks Claude/Codex transcript layouts

findings.rationale: The added Command-Backspace/Delete translation is now compiled only on macOS. Non-macOS Meta deletion chords stay available to the window. Tests encode both platform branches; macOS was exercised and Linux remains deferred.
evidence: terminal_surface.cpp commandKey Q_OS_MACOS gate for deletion chords
terminal_input_test.cpp Command/Super expectations

findings.rationale: Valid high-priority defect. Lapis now persists explicit managedResume provenance containing the argument index and appended identity. It replaces only that validated pair with a newer same-agent durable record; unmarked argv remains user-owned even if it resembles the record. Validation requires an integer in-range index, valid identity, recognized resume option, and exact option/identity pair. Unrelated arguments and launch-fingerprint inputs remain unchanged except the managed identity.
evidence: apps/desktop/src/workspace.hpp: Agent gains managed_resume_index/managed_resume_identity and restoredLaunch returns ResumeLaunch
apps/desktop/src/workspace.cpp: save serializes managedResume
apps/desktop/src/workspace.cpp: loadAgents validates managedResume against the exact argv pair
apps/desktop/src/workspace.cpp: restoredLaunch replaces provenance-owned identity and conservatively leaves unmarked options unchanged
apps/desktop/src/workspace.cpp: restore/restartAgent persist the resulting provenance

apps/desktop/tests/workspace_test.cpp: managedResumeFollowsRecovery performs two actual restart/recovery cycles to changed identities m-2 and m-3, checks an explicit --session=user-original argument stays unchanged, and rejects malformed provenance

findings.rationale: Same unmeasured bounded-probe scheduling concern as GLM12-007, on explicit restart. No broad asynchronous redesign is included in this defect batch.
evidence: apps/desktop/src/workspace.cpp: Workspace::restartAgent calls serviceRunning and restoredLaunch before startLive
apps/desktop/src/workspace.cpp: restoredLaunch reads records and may scan transcripts

findings.rationale: Valid maintainability cleanup. The write-only exists out-parameter was dead; safe_existing now returns its safety result directly and write_resume_record has no unused local.
evidence: services/session/src/agent_checkpoint.cpp: safe_existing signature simplified
services/session/src/agent_checkpoint.cpp: write_resume_record caller cleanup

behavior_verified: Two actual process restart cycles advance the lapis-owned resume identity from m-1 to m-2 to m-3; registry arguments and argv received by the children agree.
The explicit --session=user-original argument remains unchanged through the same cycles and acquires no managed provenance; existing tests cover bare explicit resume pairs.
Malformed managed-resume provenance is rejected. Durable resume record version 2 is rejected while version 1 remains readable; permissions and symlink tests use an otherwise valid record.
The fake Antigravity launcher retains --conversation identity and reports resumed state.
The QA restore assertion rejects conversation IDs delivered to the wrong harness.
Command-Backspace/Delete translation is scoped to macOS; the qualified Mac exercises its exact resulting bytes.

checks.result: passed: all 22 CTest suites, formatting, compiler warnings, clang-tidy and Cppcheck
passed: 122 Python tests, Ruff and common quality checks

compatibility: Registry versions 1/2, resume record version 1, IPC version 6 and launch-fingerprint format remain unchanged. managedResume is optional provenance. Older unmarked resume arguments are conservatively user owned.

review_delivery.reason: GitHub secondary content-creation rate limit observed September 24; canonical review policy defers calls until the next local day when no reset is supplied. No server reset time was supplied.

limitations: Linux native input and the X11 QA UI scenario were not qualified; only platform-independent QA logic and its actual fake CLI were exercised on macOS.
The fake-process regression proves desktop argument routing, not real provider conversation contents.
Bounded synchronous startup/restart probes and checkpoint write retry scheduling remain optional follow-up work requiring a recovery and latency contract.
